rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.

Closest body line: L58 'The skill is already shipped... There is no separate install step.' This is not a phantom (a present-tense sentence whose subject never existed) but a genuine answer to a live reader question -- an engineer finishing a 'ship' step from tooling habit (npm install, pip install) plausibly wonders whether a separate install exists, and the immediately-preceding sentence already supplies the positive fact it corrects, so it earns its place rather than chasing a ghost. Maintainer block L75 'Lean pass ... cut "You are not typing markdown..." ... Do not restore' is a licensed do-not-reintroduce note per the rule's own carve-out (dated provenance + standing constraint); the live pull is real -- a future compaction pass could plausibly re-add these specific cut sentences since several (e.g. 'You are not typing markdown into an editor.') read as fine prose standing alone. L77 'Install mechanic is stated once... Do not restate the install path anywhere else in body' is the same pattern (real recurring failure mode in this corpus per the rule's own §6 cross-reference). No transition verbs (relocated/moved/renamed/used to/previously) found in body or maintainer block.
